purpose: Editorial portfolio significance, not measured quality. Scores are judgement calls, not probabilities.
scale: 0..100 in five-point steps. 90..100 flagship; 75..85 substantial; 60..70 solid; 45..55 focused/limited; 0..40 exploratory or weak evidence.
source: Public non-draft workStory, post and report documents from Sanity production; full text snapshot in catalogue.json; report PDFs inspected.

entries.title: Anomaly (Out-of-Distribution) Detection for Electrical Distribution Networks using Discrete Diffusion Methods
entries.valueReason: The full Master of Computer Science submission: model formulation, normal-only training, a 36-run sweep, operational false-alarm evaluation and explicit limitations. The weak detector result does not reduce the value of the research contribution.

entries.title: Grid Diffusion AD
entries.valueReason: The implementation and experiment record behind the master's submission. Substantial modelling and evaluation, rather than a demonstration of an API. This is the same underlying project as the report, not independent evidence of a second research project.

entries.title: The City
entries.valueReason: A distinctive released macOS product joining stream parsing, permission handling, tested state reduction, 3D interaction and an update pipeline. Strong evidence of product design and systems work; the contributor's replay work remains credited.

entries.title: You Inc
entries.valueReason: A substantial finance product with a double-entry model, bank integration and explicit handling of uncertainty. Removing the commercial custody layer is a consequential product decision, not just interface work.

entries.title: AndoSim
entries.valueReason: Native C++ simulation, Python bindings and Blender integration around a published contact method, with derivative checks and packaged releases. Strong implementation depth without claiming the underlying method as original research.

entries.title: Home Lab
entries.valueReason: A resource-constrained system with explicit access boundaries, encrypted recovery and a reported full restore test. Strong evidence of operational judgement, rather than a list of services installed.

entries.title: Sprint Coach
entries.valueReason: End-to-end client delivery: design, copy, implementation, enquiry handling, staging separation, approval of the shipped commit and handover. Demonstrates responsibility for a real business outcome.

entries.title: Bedroom Layout Designer
entries.valueReason: A shipped planning application with coherent editing state, undo, persistence, offline support and PDF export. Tests address selection/state behaviour, giving more evidence than a visual prototype alone.

entries.title: Conversational Timing Lab
entries.valueReason: An independent research question with causal labels, conversation-level splitting and a recorded baseline over 100,004 boundaries. The audio pipeline is not yet a trained predictor, so this remains below completed flagship research.

entries.title: HealthAgent
entries.valueReason: An end-to-end personal data product spanning ingestion, raw-data preservation, canonical storage, authentication and cloud operations. Substantial integration work, with medical claims explicitly excluded.

entries.title: Home Lab Architectural Study
entries.valueReason: A substantial architecture document with constraints, access mapping, ADRs and a measured recovery test. Strong supporting evidence for Home Lab, but the same underlying project rather than another independent delivery.

entries.title: Malware Classifier Backdoors
entries.valueReason: A research manuscript and experiment comparisons that keep clean performance beside attack success. Meaningful security evaluation, with upstream implementation credit and narrow claims.

entries.title: BrontëHF
entries.valueReason: A real client portfolio with responsive implementation, CMS handover and a live publishing workflow. Strong delivery evidence, while the visual design contribution correctly belongs to Brontë.

entries.title: GPUShare
entries.valueReason: Broad systems integration across accounts, streaming inference, rendering and accounting. The documented broken installer, estimated energy charges and trusted-file-only rendering prevent it ranking with the most complete deliveries.

entries.title: Lumen
entries.valueReason: A released Obsidian plugin and local backend with ingestion, retrieval and source-block citation checks. A coherent research workflow, though the catalogue gives no independent retrieval-quality evaluation.

entries.title: Otto
entries.valueReason: A released native Swift migration with session state, capability retrieval, tests and signed releases. Substantial integration, with the upstream voice-os foundation explicitly credited.

entries.title: Typed Diff Questions
entries.valueReason: A reusable evaluation harness with recorded runs, calibration, class balancing and a negative baseline. Valuable experimental judgement, tempered by a model reference and unverified developer bug labels.

entries.title: Wildfire PySpark
entries.valueReason: A sizeable distributed-learning coursework project with feature-leakage correction, model comparisons and concrete class-imbalance results. Limited by the unusable false-positive trade-off rather than credited as a deployed predictor.

entries.title: Cowrie Honeypot Analysis
entries.valueReason: A concrete security investigation across 480,998 events with session-level analysis, tools and two reports. Clear analytical substance, without a novel detection-system claim.

entries.title: Personal Language Corpus
entries.valueReason: A testable local analysis workflow with stable passage IDs, provenance and traceable observations. The methodological care is valuable even though the current product scope is small.

entries.title: Synod
entries.valueReason: A released journal-analysis plugin with importers, value discovery and a deliberately distinct multi-perspective workflow. Original product framing, but the catalogue does not establish the quality of its generated readings.

entries.title: Wildfire Analysis with PySpark
entries.valueReason: A complete coursework report with model and per-class results. The report fits preprocessing before its train/test split and overstates the operational value of very low precision, so it should not rank as exemplary validated research.

entries.title: Bank-to-Sheets Sync
entries.valueReason: A small but operationally useful banking pipeline with deduplication, saved state, reconciliation and tests. Limited scope, with stronger reliability evidence than a typical prototype.

entries.title: Path Tracing Study
entries.valueReason: Coursework implementation of rendering stages plus an additional sampling variant, backed by source and example renders. Good technical fundamentals within a supplied framework.

entries.title: Sharing my GPU with friends
entries.valueReason: A detailed technical account that distinguishes local/cloud routing, accounting assumptions and trusted rendering limits. Stronger than a launch announcement, but supporting the same GPUShare project rather than adding another independent product.

entries.title: Wellington Transport Network
entries.valueReason: Several graph algorithms implemented within coursework, including A*, connected components and articulation points. Solid algorithmic evidence, without claiming the supplied map framework as original work.

entries.title: Echo Stats Finder
entries.valueReason: A collaboratively shipped desktop tool with Windows builds and live-lobby/league joins. The score credits Hamish's networking and structure, not the collaborator's GUI, and recognises its historical context.

entries.title: Finlay and Lani's wedding website
entries.valueReason: A finished site used through a real wedding cycle, with RSVP validation and an authenticated organiser view. Concrete delivery and utility within a modest technical scope.

entries.title: Floor-plan Importer
entries.valueReason: A focused Blender importer that constructs editable scene geometry from sample structured plans. Useful integration and geometry work; the external OpenArchSpecs project owns the format.

entries.title: Geometry and Shader Study
entries.valueReason: Implemented geometry, normals, texture techniques and shadow mapping with retained submission screenshots. Substantive graphics coursework, but narrower and more scaffolded than an independent product.

entries.title: GrooveBox
entries.valueReason: A working pattern sequencer and instrument with Python UI and native audio experiments. More than a mock-up, but unbundled and without demonstrated timing or reliability evaluation.

entries.title: Music Genre Classification
entries.valueReason: A substantial coursework preprocessing and model-comparison workflow with retained data and predictions. Re-running requires a missing test split, and the catalogue gives no strong held-out performance result.

entries.title: Putting my Apple Health data in one place
entries.valueReason: A concise first-hand account of the health pipeline and infrastructure. Useful supporting explanation, but less depth than the product case study and with the proposed correlation work still prospective.

entries.title: Splitting GPUShare into two services
entries.valueReason: A focused architecture/refactoring note with concrete request paths and operational limitations. Useful engineering explanation, though narrower than the main GPUShare piece and with the installer still broken.

entries.title: TransitSync
entries.valueReason: A working calendar-to-transit prototype with a separately published routing package. Meaningful integration and domain work, held below shipped products because the hosted version never launched.

entries.title: Wake-on-Join Minecraft
entries.valueReason: An on-demand infrastructure design with templates, a stable-address problem and a runbook. Useful operational scope, but no measured wake latency or cost outcome in the catalogue.

entries.title: Birthday Gallery
entries.valueReason: A completed, personally specific 3D gallery with custom modelling and camera choreography. Stronger creative authorship than a generic demo, though it remains a small private experience.

entries.title: Boids Simulation
entries.valueReason: Force-based flocking, obstacle handling and interactive controls with retained results. Good graphics coursework within a supplied framework, rather than a novel simulation method.

entries.title: DropETA
entries.valueReason: A working delivery-planning prototype with insertion previews and recalculated ETAs. Useful interaction design, but the routing is explicitly the weaker unfinished part.

entries.title: L-system Generator
entries.valueReason: A working procedural-rule editor, persistence and OBJ export. Demonstrates geometry and tooling fundamentals; the 3D mesh construction remains unfinished.

entries.title: Watzon
entries.valueReason: A community-oriented bot with multiple league queries and packaged historical releases. Real integration work, but the upstream game's shutdown means it is no longer a current usable service.

entries.title: 3D Spanning Trees
entries.valueReason: A small released graph-to-geometry tool and Blender add-on. Concrete algorithmic implementation, but deliberately limited scope and little ongoing development.

entries.title: Cookie Cat
entries.valueReason: A playable coursework game with procedural reachability, upgrades and a recorded walkthrough. A finished exercise using third-party art, not a major independent game product.

entries.title: Metlink Departures Display
entries.valueReason: A focused home-use service with both web and terminal views and a systemd setup. Real utility, but a small API integration rather than substantial routing or product work.

entries.title: Piano Waveform Visualiser
entries.valueReason: A working native audio-synthesis and waveform tool in C++/SDL2. Useful signal-processing fundamentals within a small interactive study, with MIDI and file input unfinished.

entries.title: Pinterest Aesthetic Analysis
entries.valueReason: A reproducible embedding/clustering workflow with saved image assignments and a dated 171-image run. Interesting exploratory analysis, not a validated account of aesthetic preference.

entries.title: Flat Power Calculator
entries.valueReason: A useful household calculator with live energy integration and reusable calculation/formatting logic. Small scope and no tests yet, so it should not sit alongside major finance or infrastructure projects.

entries.title: Piano Improvisation Helper
entries.valueReason: A working browser preview-analysis path with visible alternative key estimates. Scope and evidence are modest, and microphone recognition remains a placeholder.

entries.title: Sentient Environment Explorer
entries.valueReason: A visual reinforcement-learning prototype with saved checkpoints and controls. The catalogue establishes a functioning experiment interface, not strong learned behaviour or a comparative evaluation.

entries.title: Parametric Bookshelf
entries.valueReason: A reusable geometry-node asset with the editable construction preserved. A legitimate small modelling piece, rather than a broad software or research contribution.

entries.title: ArticulateAI
entries.valueReason: An early recorded-audio/API workflow with useful historical learning value. Mostly sequential service integration, and its 2023 model names need updating before it runs again.

entries.title: Spotify Playlist Demographics
entries.valueReason: A working retrieval/extraction/charting experiment, but demographic inference from incomplete biographies has substantial validity limits. Exploratory only, not strong evidence of reliable demographic analysis.
